note: Authored populations, no campaign/bridge claim. No new training trajectories; original 480-fight corpus reused with original value labels. More passes do not create new training experience.

prior_probe.interpretation: Final prior-regularized score can prefer an exact zero-return action to an exact winning action. This is not a backup error or proof that the trained checkpoint causes the same failure in benchmark fights.
prior_probe.scope: Post-hoc synthetic selection diagnostic; original study configuration and source unchanged.

prior_probe_review.finding: Real decision-quality limitation consistent with finite prior regularization; no simulator/backup arithmetic error.
prior_probe_review.recommendation: Compare Q scaling and final-choice-only empirical Q over evaluated finalists at a fixed budget after this frozen study.
prior_probe_review.scope: Exact supplied-prior fixtures do not establish the contribution to benchmark losses. Finite winning samples are not a proof across every hidden world.

confirmation.rule: If any scaling/longer-leaf candidate has strictly more challenge wins than 24x4, freeze the best by wins/return/fewer sims and compare it with 24x4 on fresh development starts. Exploratory confirmation, no held-out test or promotion.

diagnostic.continuations: Every legal action, 16 common analysis seeds, 160 greedy actions maximum, 900 seconds per position. Cutoffs keep absent returns. Public-belief worlds only.
diagnostic.selection: First two original searched losses per each Vantom deck in report order. At each, first nonforced actor/search disagreement or midpoint nonforced action if no disagreement. Up to six source fights.
diagnostic.warning: Greedy-continuation values are conditional model estimates, not optimal action values or independent fight outcomes.

distillation.continuation: All epoch checkpoints within a seed share one learner trajectory from the original initializer and fresh optimizer. Source labels stay fixed.
distillation.evaluation: Every seed/epoch checkpoint on the same 48 development starts with greedy and 24x4 search; matched starts, no seed selection claims.
distillation.fit: Full training target KL/argmax and critic MSE; public opening/midpoint development target fit with fixed original behavior; no test data.

protocol.population: Existing 12 authored developed-deck families, balanced; all new gameplay uses validation split.
restrictions: No test split opened or used for tuning
No actual private state supplied to search

scaling.selection: Among healthy candidates: challenge wins, mean challenge return, then fewer simulations. Additional 16-action leaf continuation at the selected budget; compare every result with 24x4 and own greedy baseline.

protocol.statistics: Paired source-fight percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples; development comparisons exploratory. Same seeds/positions are not independent.
protocol.validation: Focused public/RNG and training checks, bounded tactical exact-value fixtures, one independent semantic review.
